Author: Subhash Chandra Sharma

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 82
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 6592 of 2022
Applicant :- Anoop Kumar

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another Counsel for Applicant :-

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.

This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking bail in Case Crime No.1035 of 2020, under sections 420, 406, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Baradari, District Bareilly, during the pendency of trial.
It is submitted that applicant was not named in the F.I.R. but during investigation he was brought into light.

Further submitted that the machine was purchased from the present applicant by the informant regarding which he received money in his account and also paid the G.S.T. regarding which there is receipt issued by the State Bank of India dated 19.09.2020.

In this way, the present applicant has committed no offence but without taking into consideration all these facts the I.O. has submitted charge sheet against him, therefore, he requested for anticipatory bail during the Anoop Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110130353/
1 pendency of trial.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In case, the applicant is released on bail, he would not misuse the liberty of bail and would cooperate with the trial.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, perusal of record and the fact that there is receipt of statement issued by State Bank of India for payment of G.S.T. by the applicant, therefore, the applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail in this case during the pendency of trial.

opennyai_summary.decision:
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he would not misuse the liberty of bail and would cooperate with the trial.
In the event of arrest of the applicant- Anoop Kumar, shall be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 25,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the learned court everyday when case is fixed unless exempted;
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police office;
(iii) The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court and if he has passport, the same shall be deposited by him before the S.S.P./S.P.
concerned.
In default of any of the conditions, this order will automatically stand vacated.
